en.headline: HAECO and CALC sign MOU to develop aircraft engine maintenance centre in Hong Kong
en.dek: The partnership will focus initially on quick-turn services, hospital repairs and engine asset management, according to the Transport and Logistics Bureau.
body: Hong Kong Aircraft Engineering Company and China Aircraft Leasing Group Holdings have signed a memorandum of understanding to jointly develop an aircraft engine lifecycle support platform in Hong Kong.

The Transport and Logistics Bureau said the collaboration would initially focus on quick-turn services, hospital repair and engine asset management. Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan described the agreement as a powerful alliance that demonstrated complementary strengths between the Mainland and Hong Kong.

HAECO, a sister company of Cathay Pacific, brings decades of maintenance, repair and overhaul expertise, while CALC is the largest independent aircraft lessor in China. Both companies said the venture would strengthen Hong Kong’s position as an international aviation hub.

zh.headline: 港機工程與中國飛機租賃簽備忘錄 擬設引擎快修中心
zh.dek: 合作初期聚焦快修、大修及引擎資產管理，運輸及物流局指有助鞏固航空樞紐地位。
body: 香港飛機工程與中國飛機租賃集團簽署合作備忘錄，擬在香港共同建立飛機引擎全生命周期支援平台。
運輸及物流局表示，合作初期將聚焦快修服務、大修及引擎資產管理。局長陳美寶形容協議體現內地與香港優勢互補，有助深化合作。
港機工程為國泰航空姊妹公司，擁有逾半世紀維修經驗；中國飛機租賃為國家最大獨立飛機租賃商。雙方指項目將加強香港作為國際航空樞紐的地位。
